title: ManhattanGrid: float classification drops last grid line on exact-multiple extents
description: _grid_size (mobility.py:794) uses int(floor((hi-lo)/spacing)); 0.3/0.1 == 2.999...9 -> grid_size 2, so snap_to_grid(0.3,0.3) returns (0.2,0.2) and the max bound is unreachable as a grid point. Fix with round() plus epsilon or decimal/Fraction-based extent math; test non-integer spacings where extent is an exact multiple.
